title: Disclosure full-platform capability and delivery backlog
scope: Proposed implementation and acquisition requirements; not a claim of current capability or universal AlphaSense availability
execution_note: The foundational release, PR19 usability fixes and PR20 administration are merged. Cited research and index operations passed local integration verification; GitHub CI is tracked in PR21. Requirement status reflects bounded delivered scope; production readiness and competitor parity remain unclaimed.

workstreams.title: A common identity, evidence and permissions foundation

requirements.implementation_scope: SEC issuer identity and co-filer isolation; security/listing history remains planned.
Immutable raw versions now have immutable extractor projections and stable source-span IDs; older captured text and citations remain intact.
Cited retrieval applies both filing-date and capture-date UTC cutoffs before selecting versions; full intraday historical availability remains planned.

requirements.requirement: Source grants for storage, AI, display, export and offline use
requirements.implementation_scope: Typed operation-specific, expiring, revocable grants and policy tests; provider agreements and production grant administration remain pending.
Research runs recheck current/captured public SEC access before retrieval, provider transmissions and artifact reads; no shared answer cache. General private/provider policy remains unimplemented.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: historical ticker changes do not merge unrelated companies; duplicate/corrected documents resolve correctly; expired grants disappear from future retrieval; cross-tenant and revoked-user tests pass across search, caches and artifacts.

workstreams.title: Public filings and worldwide coverage

requirements.requirement: Complete relevant SEC forms and exhibit inventory
requirements.implementation_scope: Full per-filing index inventories and supported-document extraction; live complete SEC coverage has not been populated or verified.

requirements.requirement: Intraday source discovery with daily reconciliation
requirements.implementation_scope: Durable bounded discovery jobs reconcile the currently ingested serving cohort with independent cursors. Intraday upstream discovery and remote-cache change reconciliation remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Japan/Hong Kong/Singapore/India and further market cohorts

requirements.implementation_scope: Job and corpus health expose registered indexed/failed/pending/unsupported inventories, preparation failures and timestamps; no production completeness or latency claim.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: a verified source register, a representative independent sample, reconciled document inventories and observed event latency through reporting activity. A ticker count never substitutes for filing completeness.

workstreams.title: Earnings calls, news and premium research

requirements.requirement: Licensed earnings transcript and audio feeds
Event calendar and live/revised/final transcript versions
Speaker roles, Q&A and audio timestamps
News/trade journals with correction and duplicate handling
Contract and delivery acceptance per provider

workstreams.acceptance_gate: signed rights for the intended uses, sample reconciliation, acceptable delivery performance, permission tests and a sustainable quote. A live feed must disclose unavailable events and provisional text.

workstreams.title: Expert research as a service

requirements.requirement: Expert screening, selection, scheduling and costs
AI-led interview integration with accountable review
Recurring channel-check cohorts and question sets
Source-linked longitudinal grids with sample limitations

workstreams.acceptance_gate: partner agreement, operational ownership, verified expert/consent records, tested review and restricted-content handling, clear costs and permitted distribution. No autonomous call or payment merely because a research agent suggested it.

workstreams.title: A research-grade document engine and reader

requirements.implementation_scope: v2 visible HTML/iXBRL text extraction is checked against 43 original SEC sources. New projections remove hidden XBRL metadata without rewriting old captured text; OCR/Office/audio remain planned.
Immutable projection-based Unicode code-point spans and exact browser matching are implemented. Structured table/cell/audio anchors remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Embedded figure/chart retrieval and source images
Version comparison and synchronized evidence reader
requirements.implementation_scope: Immutable text reader, paginated captured-version history and bounded same-document text comparison with both-source access checks; synchronized visual PDF/HTML diffs remain planned.
Document-scoped questions and exact passage inspection are connected; general highlight/annotation/bookmark editing remains planned.

requirements.requirement: Safe reader rendering and uncertainty labels
requirements.implementation_scope: Plain-text evidence and exact mismatch refusal, hidden-subtree extraction, source uncertainty and machine-assessment labels are implemented for supported public SEC text.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: difficult scans, multicolumn reports, multi-page tables and amended documents retain accurate reading order and anchors; a citation opens the actual supporting passage; malformed content cannot execute in the reader.

workstreams.title: Trusted financials, exact history and revisions

requirements.requirement: Exact observation context and source precision
requirements.implementation_scope: Co-filer values and quality checks isolated; full precision/context reconstruction remains planned.
Filing-date cutoff consistently applies to grid, derivatives and Excel; full amendment and historical database replay remain planned.
Two-date comparison classifies value, label, unit, context and evidence changes for overlapping period-spine observations; complete amendment history remains planned.

requirements.requirement: Controlled repair of historical inferred dates

requirements.implementation_scope: New co-filer/cutoff/publication/context regressions supplement existing financial tests; independently sourced wider-sector corpus remains required.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: broaden independent source expectations from the current two-issuer sample to at least 30 deliberately diverse issuers plus edge cases, followed by stratified ongoing checks. Verify periods, values, source anchors, calculations and exported results independently. Reproduce a historical research cutoff without later-publication leakage. Passing a sample is scoped assurance, not a universal accuracy percentage.

workstreams.title: Segments, company KPIs and industry packs

requirements.requirement: XBRL dimensions and segment hierarchy history
KPI extraction from notes and supplementals

workstreams.acceptance_gate: reconcile reported/managed bank measures, acquisitions within growth rates, changing SaaS definitions and reorganized segments. Peer rankings must disclose incompatible or missing observations.

workstreams.title: Market, consensus, ownership, deals and private-company data

requirements.implementation_scope: Current US SEC XML ingestion, separate cards/sources/exports and opt-in alerts implemented. Production activation, broad identifier coverage, historical backfill and non-US regimes remain pending.

requirements.requirement: M&A state, value, stake and consideration history

workstreams.acceptance_gate: correct splits and FX; no double-counted holdings; no announced deal shown as completed; no round amount displayed as valuation; documented fiscal/basis alignment for estimates and actuals.

workstreams.title: Screening, comparisons and interactive analysis

requirements.requirement: Custom comparable metrics and fiscal alignment
requirements.implementation_scope: Explicit concept comparisons retain currency/fiscal context and missingness; custom standardized metrics and alignment remain planned.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: independent recomputation of selected comps; stable company/security mapping; no zeros manufactured from blanks; no future information in an as-of screen. [Industry comparison baseline](https://help.alpha-sense.com/hc/en-us/articles/42489594638995-Industry-Comps)

workstreams.title: Excel connection and a maintainable model library

requirements.requirement: Stable metric IDs and versioned financial API
requirements.implementation_scope: Versioned financial snapshot/change APIs with content IDs; stable cross-version standardized metric identities remain planned.
Guarded local workbook refresh and preview implemented for supported ordinary xlsx files; native Excel integration remains planned.
Mapped historical values refresh with formula/manual-override guards and round-trip checks; unsupported native features are rejected.

requirements.requirement: Sources, stale states, rollback and refresh history
requirements.implementation_scope: New output preserves input for rollback and includes evidence/next guards; automatic stale-state/refresh history remains planned.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: refresh an analyst-modified workbook across earnings, an acquisition and a segment change; preserve custom formulas/formatting/overrides; independently recalculate in supported Excel environments; undo returns to the prior model version.

workstreams.title: Complete search and cited questions

requirements.implementation_scope: Indexed exact words, adjacent quoted phrases and Boolean grammar; arbitrary proximity/semantic retrieval remains planned.

Bounded lexical-plus-vector hybrid retrieval and an explicitly labelled lexical-candidate/model-reranking alternative are implemented. Live xAI account has no accessible embedding model; broad semantic/ANN/synonym acceptance remains pending.
Company, form and filing-date filters; sector/source/language provider filters remain planned.
Selected companies and immutable document versions use intersection and retain explicit historical scope; portfolios/sector cohorts remain planned.
Durable jobs retain failed/unsupported inventories; failed projections quarantine without starving later batches and support explicit restore/retry.

Signed-in owner-private questions and linked follow-ups retain scope/cutoff, previous-question/claim context, idempotency and model call bounds. One narrow live xAI reporting-date question passed; broad answer evaluation remains pending.

Exact quote/span validation, fresh projection inspection and current source/project access checks cover released/uncited evidence and saved artifacts. Model support review is explicitly not independent factual validation.

User-selected exact number literals support bounded Decimal sum/difference/ratio/growth with unit checks and complete-sign protection; economic meaning, standardized metrics and general counts remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Historical cutoff and adversarial retrieval tests
requirements.implementation_scope: Local/PostgreSQL date leakage, invalid citations, source revocation, provider failures and quoted malicious-instruction boundaries are tested; 32-source held-out questions are frozen but broad live/adversarial scoring remains unrun.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: held-out analyst query judgments, search recall/false omissions, source support and negative-query cases; no hidden failed-document coverage. Test adversarial document instructions and cross-account leakage. A generated answer must never imply an exhaustive search when scope is partial. [Search interaction baseline](https://help.alpha-sense.com/hc/en-us/articles/41666587181203-Interacting-with-Generative-Search)

workstreams.title: Research grids, deep research, workflow agents and persistent execution

requirements.requirement: Source-backed cells with overrides and change refresh

requirements.implementation_scope: Questions have explicit source/cutoff scope and fixed per-run/day bounds; configurable multi-step research briefs and per-project monetary budgets remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Deep research with counterevidence and evidence ledger
requirements.implementation_scope: One bounded question retains retrieved evidence and separately assessed counter-evidence; multi-step deep research, evidence sufficiency validation and autonomous planning remain unimplemented.
Index discovery/extraction jobs have durable leases, fencing, retry/quarantine and cancellation. Research generation itself is a reserved synchronous bounded run, not a resumable multi-step agent.

requirements.requirement: Sandboxed persistent execution and reviewed artifact updates

workstreams.acceptance_gate: blind review of complete assignments, contradictory evidence and unsupported claims; no future-source leakage; reproducible calculations; cancelled/retried jobs do not duplicate mutations; clear action history, bounded spend and recoverable artifact edits.

workstreams.title: Monitoring, alerts and portfolio dashboards

requirements.requirement: Event inbox, acknowledgement and review state
Canonical event deduplication and transactional delivery
Real-event completeness, correction and latency acceptance

workstreams.acceptance_gate: replay a real event set and account for every expected event, duplicates and omissions. Prove delivery and pause/unsubscribe behavior, then observe real source-to-user latency during an earnings cycle.

workstreams.title: Research workspaces, collaboration and publishable outputs

requirements.implementation_scope: Projects now list separately attributed cited-research artifacts with question/evidence/calculations; authorized notes and recovery remain intact.

requirements.requirement: Model snapshots, thesis and decision history
requirements.implementation_scope: Revisioned user-authored thesis notes; financial hash pointers explicitly unresolved until an archive is implemented.
Saved cited results are immutable project artifacts; formal approval and multi-revision publication workflows remain planned.
Saved runs inherit project membership and recheck every underlying source; external/public sharing remains planned.
Three local research-prompt templates with explicit template authorship until edited; firm-defined templates and generated publication workflows remain planned.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: permissions on source and derived work; correct rendering, units and citations; attribution/history survives export where supported; concurrent edits do not lose analyst work.

workstreams.title: Office assistants and linked presentations

requirements.requirement: Charts and tables linked to data/model versions

workstreams.acceptance_gate: independently calculated scenarios; correct formula dependencies; supported-platform round trips; one changed assumption updates only intended cells/charts/slides; rollback restores the prior version.

requirements.implementation_scope: Organizations and owner/admin/member policies with last-owner protection; groups, invitations and transfer UI remain planned.
Durable v2 sessions, expiry, device lists, per-session/revoke-other/logout and audit; lake/Postgres and browser acceptance.
Dedicated platform operator control plane with reviewed account/session and tenant-role administration; service accounts, multiple named operators and fine-grained platform roles remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Revocation across search, AI, caches and artifacts
requirements.implementation_scope: Revocation enforced on current sessions/projects and public saved-document pointers; AI/private caches/artifacts remain planned.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: tenant/group/shared-link adversarial tests; rapid permission changes and employee departure; safe connector failure/restart; accurate deletion and retention behavior. Contractual isolation and residency promises require deployment-specific proof.

requirements.implementation_scope: Versioned financial and comparison APIs plus indexed document/search routes; comprehensive public developer platform remains planned.

[Mobile baseline](https://help.alpha-sense.com/hc/en-us/articles/42253345516435-AlphaSense-on-iOS)

requirements.implementation_scope: Research/projects/compare workspace navigation; role-specific onboarding remains planned.

requirements.requirement: Simplified statement toolbar and advanced view settings
requirements.implementation_scope: Primary statement toolbar simplified; advanced controls and preference scope remain available.

requirements.requirement: Pinned labels, density and resizable panels

requirements.implementation_scope: Search result to immutable source to project note; broader modeling/AI context continuity remains planned.
Search gaps/errors, session mutation failure, project revision conflicts and unavailable comparisons have explicit states.
Keyboard, mobile width and reduced-motion browser checks; full independent accessibility audit remains required.

workstreams.acceptance_gate: first-time users complete company-to-source-to-output tasks without coaching; advanced users can work efficiently with the keyboard; no lost state, inaccessible controls or undisclosed missing data.

workstreams.title: Reliability, security and accountable operation

requirements.requirement: Atomic dataset publication and coordinated ingestion
requirements.implementation_scope: Atomic Postgres multi-table publication and coherent financial readers; immutable lake generations and distributed ingestion leases remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Production Postgres writes and safe migrations
requirements.implementation_scope: Transactional serialized migrations, schema-only deployment CLI and PostgreSQL account/project writes with concurrency regression tests.

Durable idempotent indexing queue with bounded jobs, one global leased/fenced writer, retries, quarantine and explicit cancellation passes local/PostgreSQL tests. Other platform jobs and distributed scaling remain planned.
Paid Render blueprint includes pre-deploy schema migration; actual production/staging provisioning remains external work.

Explicit local-only bootstrap, scrypt credential storage, separate revocable operator sessions, origin/CSRF protection and reviewed privileged writes. MFA, broader encryption/key lifecycle, deployment least-privilege verification and independent assurance remain planned.
Isolated restart/lease expiry, byte restoration, preparation retry and cancellation tests exist; coordinated production database/object-store restore drills remain pending.

Research exposes job/corpus freshness/completeness and per-run provider call/token counts with unknown failed-call usage. Full service latency metrics and commercial cost accounting remain planned. Operator views expose registered research coverage/failures, incomplete inventories, observed discovery age and serving runs/publication; production latency/cost instrumentation and service commitments remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Independent security assessments and buyer-specific assurance

workstreams.acceptance_gate: production restore/replay, load tests, corrected-source recovery, visible stale/partial states and incident drills. Commit to contractual service levels only after measured operation and affordable coverage.

requirements.requirement: Portable user research and exit procedures
requirements.implementation_scope: Account-authorized portable project JSON with saved notes, revisions and currently resolved source references; cross-product import, full account portability and exit administration remain planned.

requirements.requirement: Real customer workflow and renewal comparisons
Commercial launch gates and accountable ownership

workstreams.acceptance_gate: billing/entitlement lifecycle, migrated data reconciliation, repeat real usage, supported workflows completed with fewer or no additional corrections, credible support and a sustainable contribution margin.
